contract.preview_identity: Private WeakMap binds original object to exact raw and expectedRaw; checked inside lock, retry preserved on failure, consumed on confirmed success.

contract.storage: WebLock, preview-time raw CAS, immediate-before-write raw check, readback and exact prior/proposed recovery; no merging, eviction or future-version rewrite.
contract.authority: Reported-only remains no-order; planned copy/prepare retains current publication/event/time checks.
